summary: Iran attacked a commercial vessel in the northern Persian Gulf while conducting ballistic missile tests during large-scale IRGC exercises. Israeli forces killed multiple Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza, including senior commanders, and struck a tunnel shaft in Khan Younis. Hezbollah has reportedly rearmed with Iranian funding for a potential new war with Israel.

IRGC Aerospace Force test-launched two ballistic missiles from the Lut Desert in Kerman during nationwide exercises. (Source: @shin_persian/11571)
Israeli airstrikes killed four Hamas and PIJ operatives in Gaza, including a Nukhba Force commander and a Hamas sniper. (Source: @manniefabian/59436)
IDF eliminated two Hamas commanders: an intelligence officer in Gaza City and an engineering officer, citing ceasefire violations. (Source: @manniefabian/59430)
Three Palestinian operatives emerging from a tunnel in Khan Younis were targeted; secondary explosions indicated weapons in the shaft near the Yellow Line. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)
Hezbollah spent three months rearming with tens of millions from Iran, producing attack drones, acquiring explosives, and rebuilding command structures. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)
US KC-46 tankers departed Pease base after suspected bomber mission preparation for Iran, though may relate to STRATCOM exercise. (Source: @shin_persian/11579)

sections.executive_summary: Iran attacked a commercial vessel in the northern Persian Gulf while conducting ballistic missile tests during large-scale IRGC exercises. Israeli forces killed multiple Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza, including senior commanders, and struck a tunnel shaft in Khan Younis. Hezbollah has reportedly rearmed with Iranian funding for a potential new war with Israel.

points: A ship was hit by Iran 80 km off Kuwait and 90 km off Basra, Iraq, at coordinates 29.0964, 49.1818, with fire detected on the vessel. (Source: @shin_persian/11578)

IRGC Aerospace Force conducted large-scale nationwide exercises including an unverified test launch of two ballistic missiles from the Lut Desert in Kerman, southeastern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11571)
Anti-aircraft activity was reported on the Andimeshk-Ahvaz road in Khuzestan Province, Iran, via delayed monitoring feed. (Source: @shin_persian/11580)
A UAV was observed over Baharestan toward Sepahan Shahr in Isfahan Province, Iran, via delayed monitoring feed. (Source: @shin_persian/11585)
A presumed IRIAF Hercules aircraft was seen on Mehrabad runway in Tehran, ready for takeoff, via delayed monitoring feed. (Source: @shin_persian/11584)
US Air Force tanker numbers (KC-135 and KC-46) held steady at approximately 193 across Europe and CENTCOM after rapid return from Pease base. (Source: @shin_persian/11568)
Multiple KC-46A tankers (REACH227, REACH679, SKATER77-80) departed Pease base after suspected bomber mission preparation for Iran, some on Bomb Mission Codes. (Source: @shin_persian/11579)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir reportedly warned that Netanyahu's requested action could lead to escalation with Iran, with Iran potentially misinterpreting preparations and responding. (Source: @yediotnews25/136811)

Netanyahu, Defense Minister, Mossad and Shin Bet heads reportedly support the action, while Air Force commander and Intelligence chief positions are disputed; Netanyahu's office called reports "fake news." (Source: @yediotnews25/136811)

Dispute between Zamir and political leadership extends beyond Iran to other sectors including Hebron, with Zamir trying to block certain actions over political consideration concerns. (Source: @yediotnews25/136811)
IDF stated it is focused on missions and maintains high alert on all fronts due to various warnings and sensitivity of current period, referring to elections. (Source: @manniefabian/59434)
IDF emphasized operational activities are solely security-related, professional, and statesmanlike, dismissing other discourse as misleading and irrelevant. (Source: @manniefabian/59434)

Israeli parliamentary elections began with 12,018 polling stations open for 7,331,981 eligible voters, operating until 22:00 with special arrangements for accessibility. (Source: @yediotnews25/136818)

Trump administration allies privately discussed Netanyahu-Eisenkot unity government post-election; Netanyahu offered to abandon far-right partners, arguing he is best partner for resuming military operations against Iran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8929)

Three Palestinian operatives emerged from a tunnel shaft in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, on the western Hamas-side of the Yellow Line; an airstrike targeted the shaft and operatives, with secondary explosions indicating weaponry. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)

Israeli strikes killed four operatives: Alaa Abu Zaid and Hamdan Suleiman Ibrahim Abu Amra (Islamic Jihad), Fawzi Salam Odat Allah Sawarha (Hamas sniper), and Mohammed Anan Mohammed al-Rawagh (Hamas Nukhba Force commander). (Source: @manniefabian/59436)

Another Hamas operative was killed over the weekend; IDF says all four were advancing attacks on troops and civilians and restoring terror capabilities in systematic ceasefire violation. (Source: @manniefabian/59436)
IDF struck a military structure in northern Gaza used as a sniper position targeting forces, destroying it immediately after identification to remove the threat. (Source: @manniefabian/59436)
Hamas intelligence officer Mohammed Halawa was killed in Gaza City on Saturday; engineering officer Ahmed Zahir Fuad Abu-Odeh was killed on Thursday. (Source: @manniefabian/59430)

IDF stated both commanders advanced attacks against troops and civilians and acted to restore Hamas capabilities throughout the war, particularly recently, in systematic ceasefire violation. (Source: @manniefabian/59430)
Heavy and continuous shelling reported with three shells landing on outskirts of a town in Gaza, per live map feed. (Source: @redlinkleb/50129)
Artillery shelling reported at Wadi al-Salouqi in southern Lebanon, per live map feed. (Source: @redlinkleb/50171)
Heavy and continuous shelling reported with three shells landing on outskirts of a town in southern Lebanon, per live map feed. (Source: @redlinkleb/50129)
Lebanese army scheduled to detonate war remnants in the town of Haboush, per announcement. (Source: @redlinkleb/50180)

Hezbollah spent three months preparing for potential new war with Israel, using tens of millions of dollars from Iran to rearm, produce attack drones, acquire explosives, and rebuild command structures. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)
Lebanese security sources told Reuters that Hezbollah's rearmament includes production of attack drones and acquisition of explosives with Iranian funding. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)

A large explosion was heard in western Saraqib, Idlib province, northern Syria; initial unofficial reports suggest an ammunition depot, but circumstances remain unverified. (Source: @yediotnews25/136808)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's direct attack on a commercial vessel in the northern Persian Gulf combined with ballistic missile tests during nationwide IRGC exercises indicates heightened offensive readiness and willingness to escalate regionally. Israeli operations in Gaza continue to degrade Hamas and PIJ leadership, but the systematic ceasefire violations cited by IDF suggest persistent militant reconstitution efforts. Hezbollah's Iranian-funded rearmament with drones and explosives creates a latent northern front threat. The reported Zamir-Netanyahu dispute over potential action against Iran introduces decision-making friction at a critical juncture, while US tanker movements reflect ambiguous strategic signaling.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese army conducts routine disposal of war remnants in Haboush, while Hezbollah's covert rearmament proceeds with Iranian backing. Syrian territory experienced an unverified explosion in Idlib, possibly linked to munitions storage. Gulf states face direct maritime threat from Iranian actions near Kuwaiti and Iraqi waters. US CENTCOM maintains elevated tanker presence (~193 aircraft) but recent Pease base departures suggest no imminent bomber deployment. Israeli domestic elections proceed amid security cabinet divisions over Iran policy, with Trump administration considering post-election coalition scenarios.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of Iranian maritime aggression, missile testing, and Hezbollah rearmament suggests coordinated pressure campaign. IDF's precise targeting of tunnel infrastructure and specific commanders indicates robust intelligence penetration in Gaza. The Yellow Line reference confirms ongoing demarcation enforcement. Zamir's reported resistance to political directives may reflect institutional concern over uncontrolled escalation. Unverified Iranian missile test photo and delayed UAV/AA reports highlight monitoring gaps. US tanker movements remain ambiguous between exercise and operational preparation. Election day operations proceed without reported security incidents.
